title: Reduce R438 to 429 helpers with three source snapshots
body:
## Summary

This source-pinned local BIT word replaces nine rank-7 copied centres with three rank-1 source snapshots, then deletes nine physical helper families that are never read. The complete local rank mass falls from **5,121 to 4,989**, ADDs from **24,248 to 13,223**, and arbitrary dirty helpers from **438 to 429**, with one owned private field. The complete profile change is `-9 e7-24 e1-9 e5`.

The 132-unit reduction is **local only**. Under incumbent width-8 whole-family accounting, returned idle-owner children add 72 rank units per local call at beta=0, cancelling the extra 72-unit pruning reduction. This is not a net global 132-unit saving.

The changed F2 endpoint is `(x,y,h) -> (Ax,y+Ax,h)` for an explicit invertible 111-by-111 code. Three repaired actual target rows are minimal for the fixed clean-centre J and invertible source-recoding class. The signed lift restores helpers exactly over the integers; target correctness is asserted modulo 2.

## Scope and limits

This is a finite local construction, written proof and separate exact replay, **not a new kappa or global supplier admission**. Source-code composition, terminal decoding at actual caps, rounded precision, physical owners/access/tape and joint outer transfer remain open. Native evidence is the exact rational cap ADDRESS/copied-total calculation and complete local frame/rank invoice, not a full physical compiler theorem. The selected record is unchanged.

Only `research/bit-r438-source-code/` is added. Its two live inputs stay at canonical `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`. The registered replay regenerates the complete ordered word and compares decompressed semantics, checking source-path and same-run parent-file provenance separately. This avoids using zlib container identity as regenerated mathematical evidence.

## Test plan

- [x] Complete 651-column integer/F2 forward and inverse operators, all 429 dirty helpers and exact roundtrip; literal dead-family projection, source inverse and actual R/K/J section checked by a separate interpreter without producer imports.
- [x] All 111 rational cap projectors, 222 frame bindings and 3,552 ADDRESS columns; every literal MOVE/ADD/COPY/ERASE frame and immutable snapshot boundary in both directions.
- [x] Complete profile and scalar invoice; eleven construction-ancestry and seven independent defect controls, including a wrong integer sign with unchanged parity.
- [x] Isolated optimized Python 3.12 replay with warnings as errors and private child bytecode namespaces; package metadata and source pins.
- [x] Exact commit `99b901c9b5ac70cf441b3d7e585cc7b8744b5359`: committed-byte/source-history preflight for all 23 package/input files, with only ancestral `20ec` source history; actual read-only Git-free optimized export replay passed in 14.12 seconds with every byte unchanged. `VALIDATION.json` preserves the earlier precommit measurements.
- [x] Automatic exact-head hosted CI [39128556864](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39128556864) passed for `99b901c9b5ac70cf441b3d7e585cc7b8744b5359`; no manual rerun.

Ross Richardson, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in construction, proof, separate audit and packaging; Apache-2.0. Separate AI implementations are not independent human review or formal-kernel verification. `SOURCES.json`, `ADAPTATIONS.json`, `PROOF.md` and the registered verifier give exact provenance, scope and reproducible evidence.
